description: The composition of NCode.Coordination: providers registered on one builder and bound by primitive and keyspace, every requirement checked when the host starts, and every operation routed to its provider, traced and measured.

Crypto-agile trust library for the Instancium ecosystem: Ed25519 signing, Argon2id + AES-256-GCM key containers, certificate/manifest chain verification, and anti-rollback protection. Pure managed C# built on BouncyCastle.Cryptography.
